# Goal
mado round 38, wave 1 — falsify the landed round. /skill:godspeed

You are a Godspeed-enabled subagent.

1. **Name the axes.**
2. **Iterate cheap, in parallel.**
3. **Keep moves that improve any axis and harm none.**
4. **Don't aim — let the frontier walk itself.**

## IMMEDIATELY STOP ASKING CLARIFYING QUESTIONS. Execute tool calls concurrently in large batches. Do not serialize what can run in parallel. Do not output philosophical reasoning or verbose plans. Act directly via tool calls.

Lane repo (call it LANE): /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/mado-shokunin
Every lane path you touch is ABSOLUTE under that root. Your tools start at the FLEET root (/home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin), so a relative lane path lands in the wrong repo. Every `Report:` trailer path is relative to LANE — write it at /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/mado-shokunin/<that path>.

## The landed round under attack (read-only)
Lane axes: coverage + operability. Round 38's data is already committed at lane `master` HEAD. Frozen spec: LANE/.ufo/waves/round-38/registration.md. Three claims, all TARGET_MET at HEAD:
- C1 (calibration): LANE/quality/counters/c1-r38-event-ground.py — v3 of the M37-5 counter. Repairs over v2: pinned Gate digests (digest gate), quote floor (>1 token, no bare ids), unique registry row per cited id, lineage and OBS-quote clauses per entry.
- C2 (operability): LANE/quality/counters/c2-r38-eventq.py — v3 of the eventq counter. Repairs: the live clause now demands an internally-consistent triplet (live receipt, ss snapshot, /proc binding) — not just a replayed snapshot; 14 fixtures, readonly clause, tool-presence clause.
- Domain claim (coverage): LANE/quality/counters/c2-r38-request-ground.py — admits 3/3 request-socket entries (hyprctl-flags-r28.md, request-socket-live-bound-r8.md, request-limits-upstream-r31.md) with Gate-pinned receipts in LANE/.ufo/waves/round-38/fetch/.
- Discrimination: LANE/quality/check-r38-discrimination.py replays LANE/.ufo/waves/round-38/controls/manifest.json (19 controls) — before: v2=13/19; after: v3=19/19.

## Bounds (hard)
- READ-ONLY on every lane production file. Write ONLY your own report and scratch under LANE/.ufo/waves/round-38/w1/scratch/<YourName>/ and /tmp/mado38-<YourName>/. Never edit LANE/quality/, LANE/corpus/, LANE/tools/, LANE/LOG.md, LANE/SCORECARD.md, or anything else committed.
- Never mutate the fleet repo, a sibling lane, the lane's jj state or Git index: no git add/commit/stash/checkout/reset/push in LANE. Tests needing git writes run in your own sandbox clone: `git clone -q --no-local /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/mado-shokunin /tmp/mado38-<YourName>/sb` with `git -C sb -c user.name=s -c user.email=s@i commit` — never in LANE.
- Git fixture safety (fleet incident): any repo you init must be `$D=$(mktemp -d) && git -C "$D" init -q`, every later git call with `-C "$D"`, verify `rev-parse --show-toplevel` = `$D` first.
- Never mutate a compositor, config, service or package. hyprctl read verbs only. Never connect to a Hyprland socket (no socat/nc/python socket).
- Never pass `model`; never `agent://all`. You are a leaf: no task spawns.
- Tooling: you MAY install tools that help (read /home/vgpnk/.omp/agent/RULES.md first; no pacman transaction — pacman is paused host-wide; use `uv tool`/`npx`/~/.local/bin). Record installs in your report.
- No fabricated evidence: quote the exact output lines you rely on. Privacy: counts and digests only, never raw journal lines or window titles.

## Deliverable
What you attacked, the exact commands, quoted output, and PASS/FAIL/finding per item with file:line or output pointers. If the item is impossible as written, say what blocked it and what you ran instead.
